common_findings: N2,J1 modestly prefer E074; N1,N3,J2 tie, all medium confidence. E074 more concretely differentiates entrant, completer and current-practitioner claims and possible versus established disqualification. F05 more explicitly separates inference direction, feature, temporal target and coverage. Both conditional arguments survive; actual institutional misuse or human transition calibration is not demonstrated. Neither has established priority.

remaining_issues.E074: Mixed competence standards may have partial independent support while tracking assent. Need support for relevance, applicability to the person and proportionate discount, not merely any non-circular reason. The public course case concerns manageability/health/effort, not documented religious-assent filtering; historical course wording and the single account remain unverified.
remaining_issues.F05: No supported human transition model settles the historical case. Actual competing reports must concern the same earlier target rather than different current routines, memory or extended awareness. The toy negative-inventory countermodel is not a documented correction of an actual emptiness argument.

coordinator_text_check: The existing primary-source check and revised source synthesis preserve the course-case limits. Do not claim observed misconduct, refutation of religion, equal testimonial weights or a need for complete neutrality. F05's probability/alternative-warrant qualifications remain intact.
decision: Two preferences and three ties support a slight E074 advantage, with most reviews tying. Neither winner nor loser is automatically selected; the real application gap must remain explicit.
